During the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]<ref name="Codex" /> that lasted between [[3681 BBY]] and [[3653 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> a '''battle''' occurred on [[Velmor/Legends|Velmor]], a resource-rich [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Codex" /> in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="Velmor">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030306velmor|text=Velmor: Royalty and Rebellion|int=Velmor: Royalty and Rebellion}}</ref> [[General/Legends|General]] [[Korvan]] of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] commanded the Republic forces in a [[Ground warfare/Legends|ground battle]] for control of the planet.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle on Velmor was mentioned in the Codex entry for General Korvan in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
